recipes.title: Classic Spaghetti Bolognese
recipes.description: A hearty Italian meat sauce slow-simmered with tomatoes and aromatics, served over al dente spaghetti.
recipes.instructions:
1. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Cook spaghetti according to package directions until al dente; drain and set aside.
2. Heat olive oil in a large skillet or Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Add ground beef and cook, breaking it apart, until browned, about 8 minutes. Drain excess fat.
3. Add diced yellow onion, minced garlic, and diced carrot and celery to the pot. Cook, stirring frequently, until vegetables are softened, about 5 minutes.
4. Stir in tomato paste and cook for 2 minutes until it darkens slightly.
5. Add crushed tomatoes, dried oregano, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine.
6. Reduce heat to low and simmer uncovered for 25–30 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the sauce has thickened.
7. Toss the cooked spaghetti with the sauce and serve topped with grated Parmesan cheese.

recipes.title: Honey Garlic Chicken Thighs
recipes.description: Sticky, caramelized chicken thighs glazed with honey, soy sauce, and garlic — ready in under 30 minutes.
recipes.instructions:
1. Pat chicken thighs dry with paper towels and season both sides with salt and pepper.
2. In a small bowl, whisk together honey, soy sauce, minced garlic, and apple cider vinegar. Set aside.
3. Melt butter in a large oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat. Sear chicken thighs skin-side down for 5–6 minutes until golden and crispy. Flip and sear the other side for 3 minutes.
4. Pour the honey garlic sauce over the chicken. Reduce heat to medium and cook, basting frequently, for 8–10 minutes until chicken reaches an internal temperature of 165°F and the glaze is thick and sticky.
5. Garnish with sliced green onions and serve immediately with rice or vegetables.

recipes.title: Creamy Tomato Basil Penne
recipes.description: A rich and velvety pasta with a blush tomato cream sauce, fresh basil, and Parmesan — weeknight comfort food at its finest.
recipes.instructions:
1. Cook penne in a large pot of salted boiling water until al dente. Reserve 1/2 cup pasta water before draining.
2. Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add diced onion and cook until translucent, about 4 minutes. Add minced garlic and cook 1 minute more.
3. Stir in tomato paste and cook for 2 minutes. Add crushed tomatoes, red pepper flakes, and salt. Simmer for 10 minutes.
4. Reduce heat to low and stir in heavy cream. Simmer gently for 3–4 minutes until the sauce is smooth and slightly thickened.
5. Add the drained penne to the sauce, tossing to coat. Add a splash of pasta water if needed to loosen the sauce.
6. Remove from heat and stir in fresh basil and half the Parmesan.
7. Serve immediately, topped with remaining Parmesan.

recipes.title: Beef & Black Bean Chili
recipes.description: A bold, smoky chili loaded with ground beef, black beans, and a deep spice blend — perfect for a crowd.
recipes.instructions:
1. Heat a drizzle of oil in a large heavy pot over medium-high heat. Add ground beef and cook, breaking it up, until browned and cooked through, about 8 minutes. Drain excess fat.
2. Add diced onion, bell pepper, and minced garlic. Cook, stirring, until softened, about 5 minutes.
3. Stir in tomato paste, chili powder, cumin, smoked paprika, cayenne, and salt. Cook for 2 minutes until fragrant.
4. Add diced tomatoes, black beans, and chicken broth. Stir well to combine.
5. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low. Simmer uncovered for 30–40 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the chili has thickened to your liking.
6. Taste and adjust seasoning. Serve topped with shredded cheddar cheese and sour cream if desired.

recipes.title: Thai Peanut Noodles
recipes.description: Silky rice noodles tossed in a savory, spicy peanut sauce with crisp vegetables and a sesame finish.
recipes.instructions:
1. Cook rice noodles according to package directions. Drain and rinse with cold water to stop cooking. Set aside.
2. In a bowl, whisk together peanut butter, soy sauce, honey, sesame oil, rice vinegar, minced ginger, minced garlic, and sriracha until smooth. If the sauce is too thick, thin with 2–3 tablespoons warm water.
3. Julienne or shred the carrots. Thinly slice the green onions.
4. Toss the noodles with the peanut sauce until fully coated.
5. Add carrots and toss again.
6. Plate and garnish with sliced green onions, fresh cilantro, and sesame seeds.
7. Serve at room temperature or chilled.

recipes.title: Lemon Herb Salmon with Quinoa
recipes.description: Pan-seared salmon over fluffy herbed quinoa — light, nutritious, and ready in 30 minutes.
recipes.instructions:
1. Rinse quinoa under cold water. Combine quinoa and vegetable broth in a medium saucepan. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand 5 minutes, then fluff with a fork. Stir in chopped fresh parsley, fresh thyme leaves, and a squeeze of lemon juice. Season with salt and pepper.
2. Pat salmon fillets dry and season both sides with salt and pepper.
3. Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Place salmon skin-side up and cook 3–4 minutes until a golden crust forms. Flip and cook another 3–4 minutes until just cooked through.
4. Remove salmon from heat and squeeze lemon juice over the top.
5. Serve salmon over herbed quinoa with fresh rosemary sprigs and lemon wedges on the side.

recipes.title: Vegetable Coconut Curry
recipes.description: A fragrant, warming curry with chickpeas, sweet potato, and spinach bathed in coconut milk and spices. Vegan and gluten-free.
recipes.instructions:
1. Cook jasmine or long grain white rice according to package directions. Keep warm.
2. Peel and cube sweet potato into 1-inch pieces. Mince garlic and ginger. Dice onion. Slice lime.
3. Heat coconut oil in a large pot or Dutch oven over medium heat. Add onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes. Add garlic and ginger; cook 1 minute more.
4. Stir in curry powder, garam masala, and turmeric. Toast the spices for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
5. Add sweet potato, chickpeas, coconut milk, and vegetable broth. Stir well and bring to a boil.
6. Reduce heat and simmer uncovered for 15–18 minutes until sweet potato is tender.
7. Stir in spinach and cook until just wilted, about 2 minutes. Season with salt and a squeeze of lime juice.
8. Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Sheet Pan Chicken & Vegetables
recipes.description: Juicy chicken breasts roasted alongside colorful vegetables on one pan — minimal cleanup, maximum flavor.
recipes.instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 425°F. Line a large baking sheet with foil.
2. Peel and cube sweet potato. Cut broccoli into florets. Slice bell pepper into strips. Peel and halve carrots lengthwise.
3. In a small bowl, mix olive oil with garlic powder, onion powder, smoked paprika, dried rosemary, salt, and pepper.
4. Place chicken breasts on one side of the sheet pan. Arrange vegetables on the other side. Drizzle the oil mixture over everything and toss vegetables to coat.
5. Smash garlic cloves and tuck among the vegetables.
6. Roast for 22–26 minutes, flipping vegetables halfway through, until chicken reaches 165°F internal temperature and vegetables are caramelized at the edges.
7. Squeeze fresh lemon juice over everything before serving.

recipes.title: Classic Beef Stew
recipes.description: A deeply savory, slow-simmered stew with tender chunks of beef, root vegetables, and a rich herb-scented broth.
recipes.instructions:
1. Pat beef stew meat dry and season generously with salt and pepper. Dust lightly with all-purpose flour.
2. Heat olive oil in a large Dutch oven over high heat. Working in batches, sear the beef on all sides until deeply browned, about 3–4 minutes per side. Remove and set aside.
3. Reduce heat to medium. Add diced onion, celery, and carrots. Cook until softened, about 5 minutes. Add minced garlic and cook 1 minute more.
4. Stir in tomato paste and cook for 2 minutes. Add Worcestershire sauce.
5. Return beef to the pot. Add beef broth, diced tomatoes, bay leaves, dried thyme, and dried rosemary.
6. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to very low. Cover and simmer for 1.5 hours.
7. Add cubed russet potatoes and continue simmering covered for 30 more minutes until potatoes are tender and beef is fork-tender.
8. Remove bay leaves. Taste and adjust seasoning before serving.

recipes.title: Overnight Oats with Berries
recipes.description: Creamy no-cook oats packed with protein from Greek yogurt, naturally sweetened with honey, and topped with fresh berries — prep the night before for an effortless breakfast.
recipes.instructions:
1. In a mason jar or airtight container, combine rolled oats, whole milk, Greek yogurt, honey, vanilla extract, ground cinnamon, and chia seeds. Stir well to combine.
2. Seal the container and refrigerate overnight, or for at least 6 hours. The oats will absorb the liquid and become thick and creamy.
3. In the morning, give the oats a good stir. If they are too thick, add a splash of milk to reach your desired consistency.
4. Top with fresh blueberries and sliced strawberries.
5. Drizzle with a little extra maple syrup if desired and serve cold straight from the jar.
